reviews.comment: By far the best professor I have had. Her genuine passion for her work and students is clear and she has made me and my education feel like a priority. Reading heavy class, long essays, but gave me valuable knowledge and writing experience. Lots of opportunities for extra credit making an A easy. Great professor and an incredibly kind person.

She is super chill. So much extra credit was offered and the way she made her grading scale made it less stressful for students. Her reading HW was tough but only every other couple weeks was it assigned. Her tests are much easier than the HW for sure.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her class consisted of 6 quizzes from readings and lectures, 2 reading synthesis papers, a midterm paper, and a research paper. She offers a lot of extra credit that helped me get an A in the class, since I didn't really do all the weekly readings. She's nice and understanding if you're having a hard time in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: GEOG 430: Dr. Keegan is a great prof! I've taken 2 of her classes. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you want to get an A in the class show up. There's a lot of reading/comprehension each week and the lectures are heavy but I have learned a lot. This is a writing-intensive class so get ready to write a research paper as your final and 2 syntheses.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Doctor Keegan is extremely kind and knowledgeable on what she teaches. The lectures were always engaging and the assignments are straightforward. She gives many opportunities to do well in the class, and you can get a perfect score without even completing some activities. Great prof!

She lectures all of class but played lots of video that keep you engaged. She let everyone know on the first day this should be your easiest class, and it was. There were random in class assignment to take attendance, essays on articles you had to read and tests(multiple choice).

Her lectures are very informative but she does not read off the slides; instead, she gives her own thorough explanation of the topics at hand which are far more engaging. She made this class easy to pass, for there are several extra credit and point opportunities. Tests are mainly true and false. She's awesome ������
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring
